title: Una gran fiesta deportiva: más de 16 mil corredores de 64 países disputaron la Maratón — InfoBaires
claims: InfoBaires reports that more than 16,000 runners from 64 countries ran the 2026 Buenos Aires Marathon, including 10,615 Argentines from all 24 jurisdictions and 5,769 foreign runners.

Brazil supplied the largest foreign delegation with 2,769 runners; Chile had 499, Colombia 468, Uruguay 455 and Peru 378, and the top ten foreign countries supplied 5,261 of the 5,769 foreign runners.
The leading Argentine men were Ignacio Erario 2:16:42, Ignacio Reyes 2:21:46 and Esteban Angulo 2:23:01.
InfoBaires lists the leading Argentine women as Chiara Mainetti 2:38:25, Anahi Castaño 2:44:21 and Mercedes Piredda 2:48:11; World Athletics lists Piredda at 2:49:15.
InfoBaires reports the winning times as 2:08:22 for Bethwel Kibet and 2:23:31 for Rebecca Chesir; World Athletics lists 2:08:28 and 2:23:36.
The course passed Palermo, Recoleta, Retiro, Puerto Madero and La Boca, with the Obelisco, Teatro Colón, Casa Rosada, Metropolitan Cathedral and Puente de la Mujer among the landmarks.

verification.note: InfoBaires 2026-09-21 赛后稿，正文含参赛结构、阿根廷前三与地标列表；成绩与 World Athletics 官方页相差 5–6 秒，Piredda 相差 64 秒，逐条记录不合并。
